data.name: Shashwati
data.gender_notes: Shashwati is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shashwati means gracious, prosperous, auspicious. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shashwat', which means 'eternal, enduring'. It is also a name of the Hindu goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, and learning. The name Shashwati carries the meaning “Auspicious, Prosperous, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shashwati usually hope their child will grow to embody auspicious, prosperous, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shashwati is a name that signifies grace, prosperity, and good fortune. It is believed to bring blessings of long life, prosperity, and fertility. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality and is often used in religious and spiritual contexts.
data.etymology: Shashwati belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Auspicious, Prosperous, Gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shashwati total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
